_about: Evidence per requirement ID for layer 8 (ICS forms and EOC functions: resource requests to the state, ICS forms as documents, the wall briefing display, live conditions, the state read API; docs/plans/layer-8.md), plus earlier rows layer 8 finishes (DSP-10, DSP-11, CON-03, CON-06, FL:FR-05, SCL-09): for those the earlier evidence is kept and layer 8's appended after 'layer 8:'. status: pass | partial | deferred | designed. The cited suites run in CI on every push; the layer merges only when CI is green. tools/reqindex/traceability.py merges trace-layer1..8.json in order.
CON-13: Resource requests to the state in the ICS 213 RR blocks: cg.resource_request, _line, _step (0107) with per-event numbering, priority, delivery location, requester and position, substitutes, suggested sources, cost and finance's reply, the state's tracking number, supplier and ETA; actions resource_request.read/write/submit/approve/place/cancel (approve explicit, self-review guarded) held by the EM director, planning, mass care, AFN and field operations (packages/authz); API: draft (optionally raised from a site's supply request, FL:FR-21), change, submit, approve by a second person, finance reply, place with the state or locally (refused until finance replies when the county sets resource_requests.finance_threshold), en route, received, cancel; every step a row and an audit entry (services/api/src/routes/resource-requests.ts); two exercise requests seeded (tools/seed/src/load.ts); console screen: draft with lines, filters by event and status, submit/approve/place (state or local, with the state's number)/en route/received/cancel, finance's reply, the request's blocks, lines and history with who and when (apps/web-console/src/screens/resource-requests.tsx; nav 'Resource requests' for resource_request.read); ICS forms as documents: ICS 202 objectives per operational period (cg.incident_objective, routes/incident-objectives.ts), ICS 213 general messages drafted, approved by a second person, sent and replied to (cg.general_message, routes/general-messages.ts), and the 201, 213, 213 RR, 214 and 309 built from the event's records into one content model with the edition named on each (packages/reporting/src/ics), previewed for a scope and issued frozen with a SHA-256 and a per-event number (cg.ics_form_issue, routes/ics-forms.ts); tagged PDF (PDF/UA-1) and CSV drawn from the frozen content, every download audited with its scope (SEC-18); seeded objectives and a general message; ICS forms console screen: the period's objectives (add, met, dropped), general messages (draft, approve, send, reply, cancel), pick a form and its scope, preview the blocks, issue, download issued forms as PDF or CSV (apps/web-console/src/screens/ics-forms.tsx; nav 'ICS forms')
